Each conversation must send a stable x-opencode-session header. Your existing local key only authenticates the client; the upstream key is resolved from the selected credential reference.

en.gatewayRevealFailed: Could not read the current key.
en.gatewayRotateConfirm: Rotate the key? Existing clients will stop working.
